description: This pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," visually represents the proportional contribution of various data sources to a combined training set, with ten distinct categories shown as slices. The largest segment is labeled "NQ" in dark blue, accounting for 31.3% of the total. Following this are "FEVER" in teal (16.1%), "ANLI" in orange (4.6%), "SNLI" in orange (15.4%), "MULTINLI" in pink (11.3%), "VITAMINC" in light teal (13.0%), "XSUMHUL" in light blue (1.6%), "SCITAIL" in green (1.2%), "PUBHEALTH" in yellow (0.5%), and "MULTIFC" in dark teal (0.5%). The chart includes a legend that associates each label with its corresponding color, and each slice is explicitly labeled with its percentage value. The segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the largest (NQ) at the top right and proceeding to the smallest (PUBHEALTH and MULTIFC) at the bottom. The chart does not show any exploded or emphasized slices.
